name: Carousel
description: An Embla wrapper with previous and next controls and keyboard arrow support.
intent: Move horizontally through a set of items when vertical space genuinely will not stretch.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

parts.name: CarouselItem
parts.note: One slide. Set basis-* to show several at once.

parts.name: CarouselPrevious
parts.note: Auto-disables at the start unless looping

parts.name: CarouselNext
parts.note: Auto-disables at the end unless looping

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: An accessible name on the region
notes: The component sets role="region" and aria-roledescription="carousel" on the root and "slide" on items.
Arrow keys work when the carousel region has focus.
Content outside the current view is still in the DOM and reachable by screen readers — which is good, and means visual position is not the whole story.
Never autoplay without a pause control. This component does not autoplay by default; keep it that way.

forbiddenUsage: Unjustified carousel where a grid would work
agentRules: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md requires a justification for using a carousel. A grid is usually better.
Never put a primary call to action past the first slide.
No autoplay without a visible pause control.
Keep the controls visible — hover-revealed arrows are undiscoverable.
